column1: # GATE PARITY LEDGER -- every JUNO gate CLASS must have a JX equivalent or a
# written waiver. tools/verify/gate_parity.py reads this file and goes RED on
# any MISSING row and on any JUNO gate not classified here.
# Written 2026-08-26 after the user asked the question I had no good answer to:
# "why on EARTH didn't you use the seeds for the JX?" The JUNO had fuzz_diff
# and random_state_ab for months; the JX was proven against a 64-patch bank.
# SCOPE_AUDIT row 5 said so in writing and nothing acted on it. A note in a
# document is not a mechanism. This ledger is the mechanism.
# status: OK      -- each JX file named exists AND jx3p/tools/jx_verify.sh runs it (a file that exists
#                    but no suite runs is not a gate: on 2026-10-11 five "OK" rows named such files)
#         MISSING -- owed; the tooth is RED until it exists or is waived
#         WAIVED  -- deliberately not needed; the reason column must say why
#         BLOCKED -- owed, but it needs an input the project does not have; the note names the input
#                    (printed as NOT DONE; tools/status.sh lists it under "AM I DONE?")
# A JX column may name several files joined by ' + '. Re-mapped 2026-10-11 (JX-26) after the JX moved to
# the plugin's own code, lifted: many old "owed" names were closed by gates with other names; the rest are
# owed below, each with the option of an existing gate that will close it.
